nodes.name: FixMatch Optimization Problem
assumptions: $f_{\btheta}$ is a standard neural network with softmax output layer, $\btheta \in \Re^n$ is a long vector, $\ell$ is the number of training examples, $K$ is the number of classes, $n$ is the total number of parameters of $f_{\btheta}$, $C > 0$ is the regularization parameter, $\bx^i$ is the $i$th input image, and $\by^i$ is the label vector of $\bx^i$.
conclusions: Define the optimization problem for FixMatch: minimize the regularized empirical loss over the parameter vector $\btheta$.
nodes.label: fixmatch-obj
